domain:server#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXcN9HaZYSEUdJWEjw

**Retriage asked: lane** · `domain:server` seat 1 · 2026-10-29T04:05Z · ⛔ Not a claim.

The pre-dispatch premise reading (read-only, `origin/main` `c4c515ad3`) finds the fix's `/meta` half in `packages/spec`, so by `references/lanes/server.md`'s red line («触 `packages/spec` 的卡一律归 spec 席») this seat cannot take it. Asked: which lane takes the one PR.

- **Premise holds on both readers.** Refusal: `authoredRuleMessage` (`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`) returns the catalog entry unconditionally. `/meta`: the private `translateObjectValidations` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, called from `translateObject`, says in its own docblock that it does no packaged-base comparison. No merged PR has touched either half since #27202. Re-check: `git grep -n authoredRuleMessage origin/main -- packages/objectql`; `git show origin/main:packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts | grep -n translateObjectValidations`.
- **Correction to the card's mechanism line.** `getPackagedObjectBase` is a method of the protocol implementation (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`), not of the registry. The registry holds `getPackagedObjectOwner` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`), and that is the one the objectql validator can reach. On the `/meta` side, `translateObject` already receives `opts.packagedBase`, and the shared predicate `valueOverridesPackagedBase` sits in the same module.
- **Shape (one PR, both readers, per triage 6468439288).** The surface is `rule-validator.ts`, `engine-validation-messages.ts` and `record-validator.ts` (the message context gains a packaged-rule lookup) plus `i18n-resolver.ts`, with tests that pin both readers together. Rules match by `rule.name`, including `conditional` branch names. A tenant rule with no packaged counterpart counts as authored. Seat reading: `Clause-②: no` (a precedence change on served text) and `Metadata-protocol: semantic`. `dispatch-gates --tier` flags `i18n-resolver.ts` as a Clause ② suspect surface, so the PR must state the judgment.
- No open PR touches these files.
